items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: Tommy Darcy, this tune that, uh, Lewis Nelson used to play, I'm getting sentimental over you.

ctx.x: Yeah. We had, um, Blue Prelude. We played that. And, uh, did you ever see a dream go walking? Don't blame me. And, um, they had a lot of tunes. I covered the waterfront. And, uh, Tommy Darcy, this tune that, uh, Lewis Nelson used to play, I'm getting sentimental over you. Yeah. He played that jazz like Tommy Johnson. Really? The tone and everything was just beautiful. And, um, we had a lot of, uh, this, the, the captain of the, of the steamship, he belonged to ASCAP. I think that was the name of the recording,…
The captain liked the music? Oh, yes. Who was the captain of the boat? Oh.
